purpose: Bind the canonical V1.2 accessibility test scope plus bounded browser integration checks and an independent Android machine-accessibility source/runtime evidence track to exact evidence without converting machine-observable checks into human, assistive-technology, physical-device, RC, Stable, production, or consumer acceptance.

keyboard-navigation.method: real WebDriver Tab key traversal through visible controls

accessible-names.method: accessibility-tree names plus DOM labeling semantics

visible-focus.method: rendered focus outline geometry under Increased Contrast

touch-targets.method: 48 px default and 56 px Touch Assistance target geometry

text-scale-200-plus.method: 320 px-class rendered 200 percent text reflow and clipping checks

rtl.method: RTL direction, current-location semantics, containment, and logical layout checks

reduced-motion.method: existing canonical Accessibility Adaptation rendered acceptance

reduced-transparency.method: existing canonical Accessibility Adaptation rendered acceptance

increased-contrast.method: existing canonical Accessibility Adaptation rendered acceptance

forced-colors.method: existing canonical Accessibility Adaptation rendered acceptance

grayscale.method: Chrome achromatopsia simulation with semantic text and structural-state checks

color-vision-accessibility-machine-obser.method: Chrome deuteranopia/protanopia/tritanopia simulation with non-color semantic/structural checks

mobile-accessibility.method: 320 px-class containment plus 48 px target geometry

far-view-accessibility.method: far-view semantic scene plus 56 px target geometry

material-readability-machine-observable-.method: text remains visible, unblurred, unfiltered and structurally explicit in accessibility fallbacks

living-frosted-accessibility-integration.method: Verify canonical Reduced Motion/Transparency, Increased Contrast, Forced Colors, 48 px default targets, 56 px Touch Assistance, 200 percent compact reflow, deterministic material fallback, and readable disabled content on the Living Frosted signature path.
living-frosted-accessibility-integration.doesNotEstablish: human optical, assistive-technology, native, or physical-device accessibility acceptance

personalization-accessibility-integratio.method: Verify accessibility-tree button names, 48/56 px target floors, Reduced Transparency precedence over accent/wallpaper atmosphere, Increased Contrast boundaries, 200 percent compact reflow, Forced Colors suppression of decorative atmosphere, and semantic-warning survival.
personalization-accessibility-integratio.doesNotEstablish: screen-reader, TalkBack, VoiceOver, native adapter, or physical-device accessibility acceptance

android-machine-accessibility.method: Verify machine-observable Android accessible names, native Button roles, state-bearing Quick Settings content descriptions, 48 dp default targets, 56 dp Touch Assistance targets, 200 percent text-scale reachability, and Reduced Transparency semantic-state reachability on the bounded Android handheld emulator reference.
android-machine-accessibility.doesNotEstablish: TalkBack, Switch Access, Voice Access, human accessibility review, physical-device accessibility qualification, OEM accessibility-service interoperability, complete native-platform accessibility parity, downstream consumer conformance, Release Candidate designation, or Stable promotion
